text:
Anya S: Heads-up — fastpass sprint wrap this week. Need quick statuses on kernel patches, continuous-batching PRs, and KV cache warmup. Reply with: 1) blocked items, 2) who's owning follow-ups, 3) PR/link. Trying to finalize rollout plan today.

Julian K: kernel: landed most fastpath loop perf changes. One flaky test blocking merge (seq-window). @Priyanka R looking into it. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821

Priyanka R: reproducing locally — failing on macOS CI, appears to be race in batch-coordinator. I can take it, ETA EOD. assigning to me.

Sam T: continuous-batching: seeing tail-latency regression after microbatch change. Me + Kevin debugging. Hypothesis: batch grouping causes out-of-order KV lookups. Example log: ```WARN kv: miss rate spike=0.23 at 2024-07-12T10:32Z```

Kevin L: pushed instrumented build to canary: https://ci.redwood/abuild/9882. please exercise with perf harness. no rollback yet.

ci-bot: Build #9882: tests 154/156 passed. flaky: kernel/seq-window-test. https://ci.redwood/9882/logs

Anya S: For rollout: if Priyanka lands fix by EOD and Sam/Kevin confirm tail lat under 95th SLO on canary, plan is canary -> 50% tonight. Who will trigger canary deploy?

Sam T: @Julian K and @Kevin L can trigger; I will monitor metrics and abort if error >5%. I'll add short runbook note.

Julian K: I can trigger at 8pm PT — ping me in this thread after merge.

Priyanka R: merged fix @1761112500. PR closed.

Kevin L: Canary deployed at 20:05 PT. Observed small CPU bump, tail latency down ~12% in initial run. Dash: https://dash.redwood/runtime/canary/176111

Sam T: Monitoring... 95th=82ms, 99th=210ms -> within SLO. No errors increase.

Anya S: Ownership: Priyanka = kernel fix owner; Sam/Kevin = continuous-batching ops; Julian = deploy; Anya = rollout owner. Dependencies: infra needs to flip kernel flags in prod config (infra-ticket #634). @infra-bot please ack.

infra-bot: Ticket #634 acknowledged. Will schedule flag push after canary success.

Julian K: If metrics stay stable for 30m, we do 50% at 21:00 PT. I'll post a final ping.

Sam T: adding note to ops-runbook: short checklist + abort criteria.

Anya S: Thanks all. If anything blocks, drop a one-liner here. :thumbsup:
